title: Felipe Almeida
text:
PhD Candidate, Agricultural Economics
    University of Nebraska–Lincoln

    
My research lies in agricultural and applied economics, with a focus on agribusiness and its interactions with broader economic outcomes. I study both macroeconomic dynamics, such as labor markets and GDP performance, and micro level issues in crop and livestock production, emphasizing their economic and environmental dimensions. More recently, my work has examined the role of biofuels and their associated economic and environmental impacts, as well as marginal abatement cost in crop production. I am currently developing a project on beef sustainability in Nebraska, focusing on carbon intensity and environmental footprints linked to feedstuffs.
